def get_packages(files: Optional[List[str]]=None, stdin: bool=False) ->List[
    Package]:
    if stdin:
        reqs = read_requirements(sys.stdin, resolve=True)
    elif files:
        reqs = itertools.chain.from_iterable(
            read_requirements(f, resolve=True) for f in files
        )
    else:
        import pkg_resources
        reqs = [SafetyRequirement(f"{pkg.project_name}=={pkg.version}") 
                for pkg in pkg_resources.working_set]

    packages = {}
    for req in reqs:
        name = canonicalize_name(req.name)
        if name not in packages:
            packages[name] = Package(
                name=req.name,
                version=next(iter(req.specifier)).version if is_pinned_requirement(req.specifier) else None,
                requirements=[req],
                found=getattr(req, 'found', None),
                insecure_versions=[],
                secure_versions=[],
                latest_version_without_known_vulnerabilities=None,
                latest_version=None,
                more_info_url=None
            )
        else:
            packages[name].requirements.append(req)

    return list(packages.values())
